scope: 52 individual document/schema witnesses; finite and structural claims are distinguished.

evidence.description: minimal valid document

witnesses.audit: The minimal version plus empty operations document is conformant.
witnesses.status: source/assertion or pinned-case binding audited; final independent review pending

evidence.description: missing required `operations` field
a text that is not an object declares no version

witnesses.audit: Missing operations and a non-object cannot produce a conformant document.

evidence.description: An alias identifies its operation, whose bindings are those whose operation member holds its key (section 5.1, Aliases).

witnesses.expectation: Alias used as a binding operation key

witnesses.expectation: Kind-only source and two bindings sharing it

witnesses.status: source/assertion or pinned-case binding audited; final independent review pending

witnesses.expectation: Source data interpreted as OBI schemas

evidence.description: An $id in a source's data does not identify a contained schema resource; its URI remains external (§§5.5, 7.2).

witnesses.audit: Malformed-looking references/anchors and large exact values in source data stay opaque; data does not register schema resources.

witnesses.audit: Both bindings remain associated with the operation regardless of preference or deprecation.

witnesses.expectation: Absent kinds accepts any exact kind

witnesses.expectation: Out-of-schema example does not invalidate document

a pointer into an example value

evidence.description: document declares an unknown kind on a source
A non-empty kind is an opaque string without a name grammar (§6): white space, a prototype-like name, and a URI-shaped string are kinds.

witnesses.audit: Unknown and URI-shaped kinds remain opaque nonempty strings.
witnesses.status: source/assertion or pinned-case binding audited; final independent review pending

witnesses.expectation: Case folding or inferred compatible versions
witnesses.audit: Kind filters compare decoded exact strings; case variants and extra whitespace do not match. No version compatibility inference is implemented.

witnesses.audit: Present null is returned as a JSON null value.

evidence.description: A document may define an operation whose key is a host-language prototype name, and that key identifies it.
An alias identifies its operation, whose bindings are those whose operation member holds its key (section 5.1, Aliases).

witnesses.audit: A declared prototype-like key resolves normally, as does an exact alias.
witnesses.status: source/assertion or pinned-case binding audited; final independent review pending

evidence.description: A prefix of a key identifies no operation: only an equal string does (section 5.1).
Dots carry no structure (section 5): a trailing segment of a qualified alias identifies no operation.

witnesses.audit: Neither a prefix nor a trailing dot-separated alias segment identifies the complete name.
witnesses.status: source/assertion or pinned-case binding audited; final independent review pending

witnesses.audit: An example contradicting output:false is still author content in a conformant document; binding author flags remain available.
